svg.title: Rosewood Park horse race at full gallop
svg.desc: An animated horse race with five jockeys, a roaring grandstand crowd, waving flags, a tote board, a photo-finish camera and dust behind every hoof.

g.text: PHOTO FINISH - RACE 7 - 1000 M - TRACK GOOD -
